findings.mechanism: Frozen v1 reader scans only the context projection after excluded NUL files have been omitted
findings.evidence: TestReviewResolveDraftRefusesExcludedNUL and TestReviewFrozenV1RefusesExcludedNUL fail on the candidate
findings.required_regression: ResolveDraft and refresh refuse NUL under declared runtime/build roots and non-whitelisted roots before any frozen v1 identity is produced; clean control remains allowed
findings.narrowing_mutant: Scan only the context projection instead of the full frozen skill snapshot

findings.mechanism: Schema-1 trust pin stores or authorizes v2 digest text with no framing version comparison
findings.evidence: TestReviewV2RejectsLegacyPin and TestReviewNewV2PinCarrierVersion fail on the candidate
findings.required_regression: CLI audit --allow produces an explicit v2 carrier; legacy v1 pins authorize only v1; synthetic equal digest text across versions never shares approval
findings.narrowing_mutant: Ignore pin hash_version when deciding a v2 subject

findings.mechanism: Maintained tests observe empty returned digest or missing cache, so an unused v1 NUL hash before refusal is invisible
findings.evidence: M-order-existing-tests passes all three maintained tests; TestReviewSourceAuditNeverHashesNULV1 passes on candidate and fails mutant with one v1 NUL hash observed
findings.required_regression: Observe v1 hash invocation at CheckSourceAudit and the other guarded production entries, separately from their returned digest and cache effects
findings.narrowing_mutant: Perform and discard ContentSHA256WithVersion(snapshot,nil,VersionV1) inside the NUL refusal branch before returning the unchanged refusal
